name: tamil_ai_app
description: An AI-powered mobile web application designed for high-accuracy (90–95%) Tamil grammar analysis, *Vallinam/Otru* (*வல்லினம் மிகும்/மிகா இடங்கள்*) correction, contextual Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) for polysemous words (e.g., *படி*, *ஆறு*), English voice-to-natural-Tamil translation, and phonetic Tamil typing.
